messages:
sam: starting a gradual roll from v4.0.0-beta -> 10% in us-east at 14:00 PT. 10m smoke, then stop/go. watching p95/p99, rerank accuracy, and kv-cache pressure. changelog: https://redwood.internal/rel/4.0.0-beta :rocket:

lee: noted. I'll monitor p95/p99 and 5xx. rollback trigger: 5xx > 0.4% sustained 5m or p99 > 400ms on >2 hosts.

nina: Q: are we using the new async-attn kernel on this canary? curious about memory footprint.

sam: yes, async-attn enabled on the canary pool. workload sample suggests slight mem increase but better throughput. fallback variant without async-attn exists.

monitor-bot: initial metrics snapshot: qps: 90->99 (10% bump); p50: 42ms; p95: 160ms; p99: 220ms; 5xx: 0.08%; kv-cache occupancy: 68%. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/rollouts/7965432100

deploy-bot: rollout applied to 10% us-east. canary checks enabled. autodrain: OFF.

lee: seeing a small cluster of higher p95 on route /v1/chat/stream rerank (external). investigating upstream calls.

sam: hold for now if p99 > 350ms on any host group. prefer per-route pin over full rollback if it's isolated.

nina: we can do per-route pinning. manifest ready: route=/v1/chat/stream pin=v4.0.0-beta-no-async percent=3 reason=upstream-rerank

monitor-bot: alert: host-group-3 p99=410ms, cpu burst 78% on those pods.

deploy-bot: automated hold triggered. rollout paused at 10%. health-check failed: host-group-3 p99 breach.

lee: after pinning /v1/chat/stream to no-async variant at 3%, p99 on host-group-3 down to 190ms. overall p99 now 210ms.

sam: good. keep the hold for 12m to ensure there isn't a ripple. no rollback for now. we'll resume to 30% with a 5m bump if stable.

nina: filing an infra follow-up for async-attn warmup GC behavior. tagging runtime team.

deploy-bot: pin applied and recorded. rollout remains paused at 10%. manual resume required. thread closed pending manual resume decision.

sam: thanks team. nice quick remediation.
